title: A bounded context is retired by retire without a concept, as an entry of its own kind; a retirement competes like any version
situation: 0319 realized retiring a bounded context. Its code review found that a retirement on one joined line and a new description on another, each superseding the same description, read as a live context with nothing showing the conflict, and a close dropped the retirement; that bringing a context back superseded only the retirement, so a runtime predating retirement read the old and new descriptions as competing; and that the history, decisions and close explanations did not say what retirement changes in them.
decision: As 0319, with (1), (4) and (6) restated and (7) added. (1) retire takes its concept optionally; without one it retires the bounded context named, with the reason, as an entry of its own kind, retire-context: the context, the reason, and the current descriptions and retirements it supersedes. A runtime that predates it reads it past (0297). It is refused for a context the journal does not have, one already retired, and a delivered one. (4) define, supersede, retire and decide naming a retired context are refused, naming the remedy. context with a reason brings it back by a new description superseding the retirement and every description the retirement superseded, subject and relation carried, where left out, from the description the retirement superseded; its concepts and decisions then read as they stood. accept and deprecate are not refused. (6) Closing the books carries nothing of a retired context; a retirement competing with a description opens as a retire-context entry of its own beside the description's opening, so the two still compete. (7) A context is retired only while its one current entry is a retirement; while a retirement and a description are both current, the context is shown with its competing descriptions, the retirement among them marked retired with its reason, until a later description or retirement supersedes them all.
consequences: Supersedes 0319. What joined lines recorded about a context is kept, never chosen between. One builder; review Ask.
